Copy the file into your home folder and unpack it with:
$ tar -xzf tools.tar.gz
Then from the new folder you can start the installer.

Give the script the right permissions:
$ chmod 755 deploy.sh
Then call it from your terminal whenever you need a release.

Install the package first:
$ pip install requests
Then open a Python prompt and import it.

Create the folder for the logs:
$ mkdir -p /var/log/myapp
Then restart the service so that it picks up the change.

Add your user to the group:
$ sudo usermod -aG docker alice
Then log out and back in again.
